modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Barnes (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injury.detail: Barnes was a late addition to the injury report and could sit out the front end of this back-to-back set. If the star forward is unable to suit up, Jakob Poeltl, Kyle Anderson and Allen Graves would all be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Kuminga (shoulder) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 106-98 win over Portland and did not return. He closed with 13 points (5-12 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), nine rebounds and one assist across 29 minutes.
injury.detail: Kuminga put together a productive performance before aggravating his right shoulder on a shot attempt, exiting at the 6:35 mark of the fourth quarter and not returning. The forward's next chance to suit up will come Tuesday in a rematch against Portland, though the quick turnaround makes his availability highly questionable pending further updates. Should Kuminga miss time, Terrence Shannon could see an increased workload.
